mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cash_flow WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_excluded = FALSE AND settle_block_id IS NULL) AS cashFlowUnlinkedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cash_flow WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS cashFlowTotalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tax_invoice WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND is_excluded = FALSE AND settle_block_id IS NULL) AS taxInvoiceUnlinkedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tax_invoice WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS taxInvoiceTotalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = st.project_id WHERE sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb.status IN ('PENDING', 'WAITING') AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) AS settlementUnlinkedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') AND company_id = #{companyId}) AS settlementInProgressCount
